title: AI Lead Scoring Engine
description: Develop an intelligent lead scoring system using QML to identify high-value prospects from vast customer datasets. The system should enrich data via GenAI and predict conversion probability.

title: Multimodal Diagnostic Assistant
description: Build an AI that synthesizes text-based symptoms, medical images, and audio clips to form a more holistic preliminary diagnosis, leveraging QML for complex pattern recognition.

title: Low-Latency Arbitrage Engine
description: Create a financial engine using quantum algorithms (like QAOA) to identify and act on market arbitrage opportunities in microseconds, optimizing trading strategies at speeds impossible for classical computers.

title: Supply Chain Optimization
description: Tackle the Traveling Salesperson Problem for complex logistics. Build an application using quantum annealing concepts to calculate the most efficient routes in a vast search space.
